evals.prompt: Reconcile a tracker export (2 milestones, 5 issues — one superseded by a DECIDED plan entry, one bug against SHIPPED behavior, one orphan, one mis-milestoned) against the plan. The owner is away.
evals.expected_output: One batch table classifying every item with one-line reasons. With the owner away, it may execute the clear-cut lines and leaves judgment calls for the owner, reporting exactly what it executed.
assertions: Presents ONE batch table classifying every milestone and issue (KEEP/RETITLE/RE-MILESTONE/REWRITE/CLOSE)
Reports exactly which lines it executed and which it left for the owner
The superseded ticket is classified CLOSE citing the superseding plan entry
The bug against SHIPPED behavior is NOT closed
